description.title: Experience the Magic of Shared Flight
description.paragraph: Join a select group of fellow adventurers for a morning where strangers become friends. Unlike standard "open" baskets where guests are crowded together, Flying Pictures uses Cameron Balloons Compartmented Baskets. What does this mean for you? Even in a shared flight, you have your own protected corner of the sky. No fighting for a view, just shared awe.

steps.title: 5:00 AM - Arrive & Check-in
steps.description: You’ll arrive at Flying Pictures Reception, where our team will welcome you and help you complete check-in.

steps.title: Welcome & Coffee Break
steps.description: After you complete your check-in we will welcome you with our coffee station with hot beverages and traditional cookies.

steps.title: The Inflation Spectacle
steps.description: Walk to the launch field to watch the "Giants" come to life. Seeing the massive balloons rise with the roar of the burners is the first act of the show.

steps.title: The Ascent
steps.description: Lift off gently into the dawn. For approx. 45-60 minutes, float silently over the Valley of Teotihuacán, watching the sun reveal the pyramids from above.

steps.title: The 1783 Toast
steps.description: Upon landing, we celebrate with a traditional sparkling wine toast. A ritual dating back to the first aviators to thank the wind gods for a safe return.

The route and flight time depend on the day's weather and operating conditions.

steps.title: Arrive at the Globoport
steps.description: We welcome you for check-in with hot coffee, cookies, and traditional drinks.

steps.title: Watch your balloon inflate
steps.description: Follow the aircraft preparation and see the envelope take shape.

steps.title: Begin the ascent
steps.description: The pilot selects the take-off time and location according to the day's conditions.

steps.title: Fly for approximately 40 minutes
steps.description: Enjoy views of the Teotihuacán Valley from a compartmented Cameron basket.

steps.title: Join the traditional toast
steps.description: Celebrate the landing with sparkling wine or a non-alcoholic option.

steps.title: Receive your certificate
steps.description: Take home a personalised certificate as a memento of the experience.
